parameters.name: AssetCleanConfigs
parameters.description: The list of asset cleanup configurations.

sub_parameters.name: CleanDays
sub_parameters.description: The number of offline days after which non-Alibaba Cloud hosts are automatically cleaned up. Valid values: integers from 1 to 30.

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic cleanup of offline non-Alibaba Cloud hosts. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of host to clean up. Valid values:

- **1**: non-Alibaba Cloud host.
